entities.name: 'Ubaydallah ibn 'Abdallah ibn Tahir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Ahmad Ubaydallah ibn Abdallah ibn Tahir was a ninth century Tahirid official and military officer. He was the last major Tahirid to hold high office, having served as the governor of Baghdad at various points between 867 and 891.
